record.page_desc: Requests recorded while Record Requests was on, by game session. See what was produced and what the judge said, then rate it. Your ratings are what the eval bench scores against.
record.open_folder_hint: Open the folder the recordings are saved in, in Explorer
record.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Turn on Record Requests in the Request Recording settings and play.
record.session_empty: Nothing recorded in this session yet.
record.select_hint: Select a recording to review it.
record.session.label: Game session
record.filter.status_judge_flagged_hint: Rated down by the judge, not rated by you yet
record.filter.status_disagree_hint: Your rating and the judge's are two or more apart
record.filter.status_rated_hint: Rated by you, in game or here
record.filter.status_in_game_hint: Still in the game's recent list, where the labelling panel finds them
record.filter.status_all_hint: Every recording the session and kind filters show
record.filter.search_placeholder: Search speaker, text, note or id ( F )
record.list.label: Recordings
record.list.in_game_hint: Still in the game's recent list, where the labelling panel finds it. Saved to disk when it leaves the list or the panel closes.
record.detail.better_title: What should have happened? Pick one, or save without
record.detail.in_game_unsaved: Still in the game's recent list and not saved to disk yet. It is saved when it leaves the list or the labelling panel closes.
record.detail.note_placeholder: Why it was right or wrong (C jumps here, Enter finishes)
record.detail.rewrite_placeholder: A better version (R jumps here, Esc leaves)
record.detail.scene: Scene the decision was made on
record.keys.list_hint: List: S/W next and previous · Shift+S/W ten at a time · Home/End first and last · Q/E older and newer session · F search
record.keys.rate_hint: Rating: 1-5 rate · Space take the judge's · C note · R rewrite · after a rating of 1-3: 1-5 and Q-T pick tags or a choice, A/D page, Space save, Esc back · J/K, [ ], /, N, Enter, 6-0 and H/L still work
record.related.settings_hint: Turn recording on, choose which requests to record, and set up the judge
